claim: Lovable publishes to [name].lovable.app on free plan in roughly one click of the Publish button
quote: By default, your app is published to [published-url].lovable.app... Click the Publish icon in your project's top-right corner... Anyone with the link can visit your published app

claim: Every Lovable project gets a free yourapp.lovable.app subdomain on any plan; custom domains require a paid plan
quote: Every project gets a Lovable subdomain, like yourapp.lovable.app, on any plan. On paid plans, you can also add a custom domain.

claim: v0's Publish button creates a Vercel production deployment with its own URL on first click
quote: The Publish action creates a Production deployment of your application using Vercel's infrastructure. When you publish a chat for the first time, a new Vercel Project is created with its own production URL.

claim: v0 free tier provides $5 monthly credits that reset each cycle, sufficient for small workshop builds
quote: The free tier includes $5 in monthly credits, which resets each billing cycle.

claim: Bolt.new now uses its own hosting with a .bolt.host subdomain that every project gets free with one-click publish
quote: Bolt made a big move in mid-2025 when they switched from Netlify-based deployments to their own hosting infrastructure, and every project — free or paid — gets a .bolt.host subdomain and one-click publishing

claim: Bolt can deploy to Netlify via Claim URL — temporary Netlify deploy first, then move to your own Netlify account
quote: Bolt temporarily deploys your app to Netlify for free when you click the Deploy icon... use the Claim URL in chat to move the deployed site into your own Netlify account

claim: Replit free Starter plan allows 1 published static app with a public URL that expires after 30 days unless republished
quote: The Starter Plan includes 1 free published app, and the deployment expires after 30 days but can be re-published. Only static deployments are free.

claim: Claude Artifacts can be published on Free/Pro/Max plans to a public URL anyone can open without signup
quote: Claude Artifacts can be published on Free, Pro, and Max plans to make them publicly available, with anyone able to view and interact with the artifact via a link.

claim: Published Claude Artifact links land viewers on claude.ai and may show a login screen if not signed in, limiting true public reach
quote: When someone clicks a published Claude artifact URL, they land on claude.ai which requires authentication, and if they're not logged in to Claude, they see a login screen rather than the artifact.

claim: ChatGPT Canvas has a Share button that generates a public chatgpt.com/canvas/shared/<id> URL on all plans including free
quote: The Share button generates a public URL for just the canvas content (chatgpt.com/canvas/shared/<id>), not the full chat... Sharing a canvas is available for all plans including Free, Plus, Pro, Team, Enterprise, and Edu.

claim: Cloudflare Pages free plan: 500 builds/month, 1 concurrent build, 20-minute build timeout, unlimited bandwidth, 20,000 files per site
quote: On the free plan, you can run 1 build at a time, with a limit of 500 builds per month. Builds will timeout after 20 minutes... Cloudflare Pages sites can contain up to 20,000 files on the Free plan

claim: Netlify switched to credit-based free tier in Sept 2025: 300 credits/month at 15 credits per deploy and 20 credits per GB bandwidth
quote: 300 credits/month with deploys at 15 credits each, bandwidth at 20 credits/GB, compute at 10 credits/GB-hour... When a web project uses up its monthly credit allotment, it enters a paused state until the start of the next billing cycle

claim: Vercel Hobby free plan offers 100GB bandwidth, unlimited deployments, 1M serverless invocations, but personal non-commercial use only
quote: The Hobby plan includes 100GB bandwidth per month... 1 million serverless function invocations per month... the Hobby plan restricts users to non-commercial, personal use only.

claim: GitHub Pages free: 1GB site size, 100GB/month soft bandwidth, 10 builds/hour, public repos only, static content only
quote: Published GitHub Pages sites may be no larger than 1 GB... soft bandwidth limit of 100 GB per month and a soft limit of 10 builds per hour... only available for public repositories when using a free personal account

claim: Free static QR code generators like QRStuff produce permanent codes with unlimited scans for sharing workshop URLs to phone cameras
quote: static QR codes that are completely free to create, download, and use forever with unlimited scans, with no hidden fees, watermarks, or expiration dates

claim: Canva offers a free QR generator that turns any URL into a scannable code readable by native iOS/Android camera apps
quote: Canva's QR code generator is totally free... enter the URL of the page you want to link to, select customization options to change colors and margins, and generate the QR code
